mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from the previous month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market supporting strong corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% from previous month signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS grow by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a low industrial production level signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation prompting restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) from the previous month signals expanding consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST rises from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and PAYEMS declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annual growth signals broad economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both INDPRO and GDPC1 grow below 0.5% annually.
